title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00133 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
17:45 - 18:00: Performed TBT for skidding cantilever to f-5.
18:00 - 19:00: Prepared and skidded rig 3m port and 2m aft.
19:00 - 19:15: Performed TBT with ongoing crew
19:15 - 19:30: Prepared to continue skidding rig. Noticed cantilever in correct position to swap hatches on f-7 and f-9 upcoming future operations on f-9).
19:30 - 19:45: Performed TBT for swapping hatches on f-7 and f-9. Meanwhile worked on flow line cover.
19:45 - 22:00: Swapped hatches on well f-7 and f-9. Meanwhile worked on flow line cover.
22:00 - 22:45: Skidded cantilever to well f-5
22:45 - 23:00: Installed stairs to access cantilever.
23:00 - 00:00: Removed hatch on f-5 and installed half moon hatches. Meanwhile opened doors on BOP. Worked on flow line cover/goose neck.
